fields.summary_ko.0: Saudi Arabia mandates filling 50% of 17 finance-related positions with Saudi nationals by May 23, 2027, applying to companies employing 2 or more people.
fields.summary_ko.1: 17 specialized finance roles including financial analysts, investment managers, and credit managers are targeted, with a 6-month grace period for implementation.
fields.summary_ko.2: Under Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 policy, unemployment has declined from 12.3% in 2016 to 6.4% in Q1 2026, with localization policies continuing to expand.
